## About

### Hi, I'm Aditya Sharma

Masters student @ 【entity-Monash University¦canonical_name=Monash University】

I believe good data work is invisible - if your audience is thinking about your chart instead of your message, you've lost them.

This blog is my practice ground for that: taking complex analysis and translating it for people who don't care about p-values and r-squared stuff, they care about what to do next.

#### What I work with

**Tools:** R, Python, Quarto, ggplot2, Tableau, Shiny, Adobe XD, Figma
**Focus:** Data storytelling, visual explanation, non-technical communication

#### My approach

**Audience first, chart second** — Start with their question, not your dataset

**One message per visual** — If you need a paragraph to explain it, redesign it

**Context over precision** — A rough number they remember beats a precise one they forget

#### Outside data
